description: Na₂W₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-46°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.27 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and corners with three equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-61°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.84 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms.
